scripts.sync:android: npm run build:mobile && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync:android && node scripts/gradlew.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.build:apk:release: npm run sync:android && node scripts/gradlew.mjs assembleRelease
scripts.build:aab:release: npm run sync:android && node scripts/gradlew.mjs bundleRelease
scripts.test:apk:all: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=./tests/apk/support/json-reporter.mjs --test-reporter-destination=test-results/apk/results.json tests/apk/apk-static.test.mjs tests/apk/apk-device.test.mjs tests/apk/apk-flows.test.mjs tests/apk/apk-turns.test.mjs tests/apk/apk-settings.test.mjs
scripts.validate:apk: npm run build:apk && npm run test:apk:all && npm run test:apk:report
